steps: External platform issues a signed workload assertion.
Local trust policy matches exact issuer, subject, and audience.
Federation endpoint exchanges it for a short-lived local token.
Cloud resource validates and authorizes the federated identity.

lesson.scenario: A CI job exchanges a GitHub OIDC assertion for a short-lived cloud deployment token without a stored cloud secret.

steps.title: Request a job assertion
steps.narration: GitHub issues kid=gh-91 with iss=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, sub=repo:acme/shop:ref:refs/heads/main, aud=cloud-sts.

steps.invariant: Federation matches exact external issuer, audience, and subject before minting a short-lived token with no greater authority than the mapped workload.

steps.narration: The runner asks for cloud audience deploy-api and scope releases.write; no cloud client secret is sent.

steps.outcome: shop-v42 deploys without a stored cloud credential.
